value.summary: Build a responsive, SEO-friendly real estate property listing site with public search, user accounts, a dashboard, admin content and product management, recurring billing, Stripe payments, and high-fidelity design. Target launch is in about three months, with a tight budget and preference for proven technology.

requirements.text: Support recurring billing plans and generate PDF invoices.
Accept card payments through Stripe, including refunds and webhook handling.
Provide a main dashboard with widgets, filters, and empty states.
Provide a search results page with filters, sorting, and pagination.
Provide public pages with responsive layouts and SEO basics.
Support registration, login, password reset, and email verification.
Support enterprise SSO login using the client's identity provider.
Provide admin CRUD for products/items, including categories and images.
Allow admins to edit static pages, FAQs, and banners.
Produce high-fidelity mockups and component styles.
Target launch in about three months.
Work within a tight budget and prefer proven technology.

ambiguities: The brief does not define the property listing data model or clarify whether products/items are property listings.
The dashboard's intended users, widgets, and data sources are unspecified.
The search filters, sorting options, and expected listing volume are unspecified.
The scope of SEO basics is not defined.
The identity provider and SSO protocol are unspecified.
The billing plans, invoice requirements, and refund workflows are unspecified.
The required admin roles and permissions are unspecified.
assumptions: The site is a web application; no native mobile application is requested.
Stripe is the payment provider for card payments and recurring billing unless clarified otherwise.
The client will provide access to its identity provider and relevant configuration for SSO.
High-fidelity mockups and component styles are design deliverables; implementation of the site is also expected based on the listed requirements.
risks: The three-month target may be difficult to meet if SSO, billing, or property data requirements are complex.
A tight budget may conflict with the breadth of requested functionality and high-fidelity design.
Unspecified property data, search behavior, and dashboard scope may cause significant scope changes.
SSO and payment integrations depend on timely access to third-party accounts, configuration, and testing environments.
out_of_scope: Property listing ingestion, syndication, or migration from existing systems.
Specific compliance certifications or regulatory requirements not stated in the brief.

unknowns.question: Does enterprise SSO require a non-standard identity-provider integration, custom provisioning, or multiple identity providers?
unknowns.why_it_matters: The provider and protocol determine integration complexity; custom provisioning or multiple providers add implementation and testing work.

scenario_if_yes.title: Implement custom or multi-provider SSO integration
Test SSO flows and provider configurations

unknowns.question: Are property listings and related data being migrated or imported from an existing system?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Migration or import requires source analysis, mapping, transformation, validation, and potentially repeatable import tooling.

scenario_if_yes.title: Analyze source data and map it to the listing model
Build and validate listing data import

unknowns.question: Do recurring billing and invoices require tax calculation, proration, dunning, or multiple plan tiers beyond basic Stripe subscriptions?
unknowns.why_it_matters: These billing rules add integration logic, invoice handling, and edge-case testing beyond basic subscription setup.

scenario_if_yes.title: Implement advanced subscription and invoice rules
Test billing edge cases and invoice behavior

unknowns.question: Are there specific legal, privacy, accessibility, or security compliance standards the site must meet?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Formal standards can require additional design, implementation controls, documentation, and verification.

scenario_if_yes.title: Assess applicable compliance requirements and implementation gaps
Implement required accessibility and security controls
